scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Heh...
It's tough
being a hero
and being shady,
untrustworthy,
sneaky...
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
呵……
当英雄可真不容易，
还要鬼鬼祟祟、
不可信任、
偷偷摸摸……

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
But when the
going gets rough
my pals know they
can count on me.
I need them and
they need me.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
但当局势艰难时，
我的伙伴们知道
他们可以依靠我。
我需要他们，
他们也需要我。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
This world needs
more heroes who are
willing to walk the line
between order and lawlessness.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
这个世界需要更多
愿意在秩序与混乱之间
游走的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Are you ready
to join the ranks
of the sneakiest of
warriors? Are you ready
to become a Stalker?
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
你准备好加入
最隐秘的战士行列了吗？
你准备好成为一名
神行太保了吗？

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
当你准备好时，
随时欢迎回来。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回到我这里之前，用完所有剩余的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Congratulations!
As a Stalker, I hope
you stab the right people
in the back. Banish the
wicked using their own
dastardly methods!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
恭喜！
作为一名神行太保，我希望
你能把匕首刺进正确的人背后。
用恶人自己的卑鄙手段
来铲除邪恶！

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
欢迎来到
瓦尔哈拉，
荣誉殿堂。

scripts.text:
[Stalker]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神行太保]
请在这里
随意放松。
向战士们致敬！
